content: In recent years,we have seen a lot of development based on this standard transformer models particularly on unsupervised pre-training(BIBREF2, BIBREF3, BIBREF4, BIBREF5, BIBREF6, BIBREF7 which have set state-of-the art results on multiple NLP benchmarks. One such model architecture has been the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) model which uses a deep bidirectional transformer architecture.
